facts.fact: FAFECA officially launched its digital incubator for women entrepreneurs in Bangui, financed by the EU and AFD; no programme or cohort is described.
President Touadera inaugurated the first youth business incubator in Bangui on 30 October 2024, run by Fondation Bangui Hub with French embassy funding; no programme or cohort is reported.
Centra News reports the Bangui Hub foundation's incubator has already trained over 800 young entrepreneurs, as of its 13 March 2026 round table.
